sloka: चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यं यं सीता स्वयमास्थिता ।प्रवृद्धः शिंशुपावृक्षः स च तेनाभिरक्षितः ।। ५.४२.१९।।।।
transliteration: cārupallavapuṣpāḍhyaṁ yaṁ sītā svayamāsthitā ।pravṛddhaḥ śiṁśupāvṛkṣaḥ sa ca tenābhirakṣitaḥ ।। 5.42.19।।।।

translations.english: "He has spared the simsupa tree with lovely, tender leaves and flowers which is a chosen resort by Sita.
